messages:
emma: Quick sync — I'm landing a tiny docs PR that adds microexamples for structured outputs (one-liners showing minimal JSON schema + example). Wanted to align on what the parser contract should say for 'compact' vs 'expanded' outputs.
raj: SG. Do you mean the SDK parser behaviour or the docs' parsing guidance?
emma: Both — the docs should state what the SDK does by default. Right now SDK trims whitespace and accepts trailing commas; parser should fail on mismatched types.
miguel: FYI runtime recently tightened schema validation for tool outputs (rejecting ints when schema expects string). That caused a failing e2e for a partner. We should note that in the migration notes.
linda: +1 to a clear migration note. Also add a small snippet showing how to opt into the older permissive behaviour via `parserOptions.allow_legacy` — we're adding an SDK knob for a short window.
emma: I'll add the snippet. Proposal for microexample format: 1) JSON Schema (minimal), 2) 1-line example output, 3) one-liner parser expectation. Example:```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "task_id": {"type": "string"}
  },
  "required": ["task_id"]
}
```
Example output: ```json
{"task_id":"abc123"}
```
parser note: "SDK will parse and return object; if task_id is missing, parser raises ValidationError"
raj: Can you show a short SDK snippet for node/python? People expect copy-paste.
emma: Yes — I'll add both. Node example:```js
const out = await client.parseResponse(res, {mode: 'strict'})
// throws ValidationError if required fields missing
```
python example:```py
out = client.parse_response(resp, mode="strict")
# raises ValidationError
```
miguel: For the migration section, please call out the specific runtime change and include this log snippet we saw:```text
ERROR validate_tool_output: expected string for task_id, got number
```
linda: Also add a short paragraph about guardrail-friendly shapes — e.g., prefer explicit enums for small sets, and avoid union-of-array unless necessary. Keeps parsers simpler.
emma: ack. One more: can someone double-check links? I updated the schema reference link but CI-bot flagged a broken anchor.
ci-bot: Link check failed: /docs/api/output-contracts.md#schema-examples anchor not found (404) — triggered by PR #3421.
raj: I'll fix the anchor in the target doc and push a tiny follow-up.
emma: Thanks. Next steps: I'll open PR draft with microexamples + node/python snippets + migration note + guardrail paragraph. Ping when CI passes and when you push the anchor fix. Aim to merge by EOD.
miguel: I'll watch the runtime change doc and add the exact commit hash once we confirm.
linda: Great — can we also add a one-paragraph 'who to contact' at the top for customers hitting strict validation? (cc: eng-runtime + support)
emma: Good call, will add contact lines. I'll post the draft link here when ready. :sparkles:
